gaps.title: Planned 768-item catalog
gaps.detail: No prior PREINCARNATION loot catalog was mounted in this workspace. Duplicate judgment against that catalog is impossible. New ids were not treated as proof of new content.

gaps.title: Campaign inventory
gaps.detail: Discovery sites, weights, and storage rules are data. They are not spawned into a county map or a campaign save schema, because neither schema is in this workspace.

gaps.title: Enemy AI
gaps.detail: narrow, flock, rhythm, burrow, keen-ear, and phototactic change an alert flag on the bench. There is no navigation, animation, or damage model.

gaps.title: Lamp props
gaps.detail: Approved lamps change a mode string. No scene light, mesh, or moth simulation exists outside the bench.

gaps.title: Diegetic audio
gaps.detail: The wax recorder stores an authored sound id. The bench can hum a stand-in for a named take. It does not capture a microphone or play a field recording of the creek.

gaps.title: Puzzle geometry
gaps.detail: Locks, gates, and compartments flip solved, revealed, or unlatched. They are not wired to door meshes or dialogue.

gaps.title: Trade economy
gaps.detail: A sale adds a local credit number or is refused as an heirloom. No merchant wallet or base-game currency id was available.

gaps.title: Display furniture
gaps.detail: The study shelf is four slots on the bench, not a room in a house map.

gaps.title: Weather
gaps.detail: Wind, wet, dawn, and pressure are scene flags, not a county forecast.

gaps.title: NPC schedules
gaps.detail: The two-note pipe sets friendApproaching. No character controller exists to walk that person in.

gaps.title: Physics
gaps.detail: Balances, sash lifts, chain lengths, and drifts are numbers, not rigid bodies.

gaps.title: Cross-pack crafting
gaps.detail: Restore materials are pack-local names (clock oil, rouge, beeswax). They are not ids from the absent base catalog.
